register: # SOURCES: Afore T4 communication protocol PDF (AFORE_T4.pdf, three-MPPT layout) and the Afore BNTxxxKTL-2mppt Solarman definition (StephanJoubert/home_assistant_solarman), which is a working model. Where the two disagree this map follows the Solarman definition: phase voltages and 0.01 A currents.

# LAYOUT: this is the two-MPPT layout (input registers 0-26). Three-MPPT models add PV3 voltage and current at 11-12, which moves everything after them up by two; that layout is not covered. 32-bit values are two registers, high word first at the lower address, so they need no endian adjustment.
# SERIAL: Modbus RTU over RS-485, 9600 baud, 8N1, FC04 for this map and FC03 for the holding map. Set the inverter's RS485 protocol to Modbus in its menu first. Minimum query period 1 s.

note: Inverter state flags; names in state_codes in the protocol JSON.
Documented as the AB line voltage (Uab); the Solarman definition publishes it as the L1 voltage.
Documented as the BC line voltage (Ubc); the Solarman definition publishes it as the L2 voltage.
Documented as the CA line voltage (Uca); the Solarman definition publishes it as the L3 voltage.
Phase A current. The PDF lists 0.1 A; the working Solarman definition uses 0.01 A.
Phase B current. The PDF lists 0.1 A; the working Solarman definition uses 0.01 A.
Phase C current. The PDF lists 0.1 A; the working Solarman definition uses 0.01 A.
PV string 1 voltage.
PV string 1 current. The PDF lists 0.1 A; the working Solarman definition uses 0.01 A.
PV string 2 voltage.
PV string 2 current. The PDF lists 0.1 A; the working Solarman definition uses 0.01 A.
Grid frequency.
Inverter module temperature. Negative-value encoding is not confirmed; compare with the inverter display.
Inverter housing temperature (the Solarman definition calls it the inner temperature). Negative-value encoding is not confirmed.
Energy generated today, in Wh on the wire. 2 registers 14-15, high word first. The Solarman definition reads only the low word at 15.
Current generation power. 2 registers 16-17, high word first. The Solarman definition reads only the low word at 17.
Cumulative generation time today. 2 registers 18-19, high word first. The Solarman definition reads only the low word at 19.
Lifetime energy generated, in Wh on the wire. 2 registers 20-21, high word first (the Solarman definition reads it as a 32-bit value).
Internal fault flags; names in fault_e01_codes in the protocol JSON.
Protection flags; names in fault_e02_codes in the protocol JSON.
Protection flags; names in fault_e03_codes in the protocol JSON.
Protection flags; names in fault_e04_codes in the protocol JSON.
Fan, sensor and breaker flags; names in fault_e05_codes in the protocol JSON.
